threads.body: This newly generated `common.v3-preview` entry is missing the four `metric_refs` declared for the exact same condition in `instrumentation/camel-2.20/metadata.yaml:143-202` (`messaging.client.consumed.messages`, `messaging.client.operation.duration`, `messaging.client.sent.messages`, and `messaging.process.duration`). The catalog therefore incorrectly reports that Camel emits only spans in v3-preview mode. Please resolve why the manual telemetry was omitted and regenerate this file.

threads.body: The new `68138657` definition omits `messaging.consumer.group.name`, but RocketMQ 5 still emits that attribute on receive points for this metric (`AbstractRocketMqClientTest.java:1113-1119` and `RocketMqSimpleConsumerTest.java:203-222`). Because the metrics parser unions attributes across captured points, this change makes the generated catalog incomplete, likely due to a receive point not being captured during this metadata run. Please stabilize/update the telemetry capture and regenerate this file rather than editing the generated YAML directly.
